content: The body is at (10,4), adjacent to the rock at (11,4). The pass opens day 5 morning; it's day 2 evening. I'll wait out the days in the meadow (waiting is the correct move — pushing the rock is wasted effort), then walk the corridor.

args.approach: Notice board interact is unsupported (unknown-input) so drop it; pass opens day 5 morning, so wait out days 2-4 in the meadow, then walk the east corridor (x 11) north to the shrine chest at (11,1) and interact.
